t: A cheap little LoRa radio board with a tiny screen for off-grid texting.
steps: Buy the board from the Heltec store or a reseller such as Rokland. Pick the radio band for your region.
Screw on the LoRa antenna before you power it up. Never run the radio without it.
Connect it to a computer with a USB-A to USB-C cable.
Check for Meshtastic on the screen. Many boards ship with it. Others need the firmware-heltec-v3 build from Meshtastic.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE and add the ESP32 board package.
Add the open heltec_esp32_lora_v3 library and run one of its LoRa examples.
meta: Open Board. From $24.95. A few stores.
